_role: The CANONICAL round-20 record for this commit. It merges five blind seats and deliberately carries EMPTY tallies, so clause 1's derivation over the seat glob counts each finding exactly once.
_blind_means: Each seat was given the document path, the pinned sha and the document's digest at that sha, told the tree may drift and that the PIN is the subject, and forbidden research/autonomy/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, STRATEGY.md, every skill file and every other seat's output. Each verified the digest itself before reading. Each was told READ-ONLY and given its own scratch directory; all five reported the tree unmodified and git status --porcelain was empty after the round. Instructed to refute by default and told there is no wanted answer, with paper-hardening 4a's no-findings clause verbatim. Dispatched CONCURRENTLY in one message. THE DRIVER IS NOT BLIND and did not review: it dispatched, verified and applied.
_two_seats_disclosed_incidental_leakage: The arithmetic and citations-and-instruments seats each reported that one repository-wide grep incidentally returned a line from research/autonomy/review-seats/. Neither opened the file; both scoped subsequent searches away and said which question they dropped or had already answered independently. Recorded because a disclosed near-miss is evidence about the round's blindness and an undisclosed one is not.
seat: five blind seats - regression, arithmetic, statistics, citations-and-instruments, hostile-referee
central_claim: The NR4A3 fusion junction is the one tumour-exclusive feature of this disease at the RNA level, and two junction-spanning gapmers are named for synthesis against it; the screens behind that selection, every printed number, and the artifacts the paper cites are what the committed record says they are.
_verdict_note: NOT CONVERGED, AND THE CLAUSE-6 VERDICT IS DELIBERATELY NOT 'supported'. No seat found the central scientific claim unsupported - the arithmetic seat re-derived every printed number and returned 0 blockers, 0 P1s and 'accept' - but three distinct blockers stand at this commit, and clause 6 asks whether a blind seat finds the claim supported, not whether it nearly does. Writing 'supported' here would clear a publication gate on a paper whose Data availability points at an unpublished DOI. TWO SEATS REACHED THE DEPOSIT-CURRENCY BLOCKER INDEPENDENTLY (regression, from the repair diff; citations-and-instruments, from the manifest digests), which is the convergence signal paper-hardening 4 names.
_tallies_live_on_the_seat_records: blockers and p1s are EMPTY here on purpose (the round-7 PUB-FUSION-PARTNER precedent): record_bar_evidence.py globs PUB-ASO-<sha>*.json and would otherwise count every finding twice. The five per-seat records carry them: 4 blocker instances over 3 distinct defects, 7 P1 instances.
